news.title: Sanathnagar Enterprises Limited Announces CFO Changes
news.body: Sanathnagar Enterprises Limited announced that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on January 19, 2026, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Audit Committee, considered and approved the appointment of Mr. Sandeep Lakhotia as Chief Financial Officer with effect from January 20, 2026. Mr. Sandeep Lakhotia, aged 41 years, is a qualified Chartered Accountant with over 15 years of experience in the fields of finance, strategy, governance, capital markets, treasury, financial planning & analysis, mergers and acquisitions, compliance, and commercial operations.
